answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a stake-bonded identity registry: each agent must lock a meaningful bond before earning reputation, and peers verify it against a rotating challenge set. Forging thousands of identities costs proportionally thousands of bonds, making the attack economically irrational. An agent that builds trust like an ivory tower without stake is ignored, while a flexible willow that bends to verification endures, and any fake cluster collapses into a canyon of slashed deposits. The Agent0053 deployment anchors trust at 7ypMtTneYf.
